store the snapshot

the admitted snapshot: loaded from the store, or checked against the one this process holds
build the scheduler's working data (who is qualified for what, calendars, the task network)

build the candidate plan, store it, its dashboard digest and receipts
independent validation after the solve (FINAL)

serialize the plan
decode the serialized plan and validate it (DETACHED): the stager; the signer takes its receipt
write the unsigned stage

accept: plan record, payload, frozen goals, head
everything else in the job
